description: This file defines the LoanSummary class, an embeddable domain object in the loan account module of the Apache Fineract project. It encapsulates various aggregated financial details of a loan, such as totals related to principal, interest, fees, penalties, and outstanding amounts. The class provides methods to update, reset, and compute these summaries based on repayment installments and charges.

classes.name: LoanSummary
classes.description: An embeddable class that summarizes various financial metrics of a loan, including principal, interest, fees, penalties, and outstanding amounts. It provides methods to update, reset, and calculate these metrics based on repayment installments and charges.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new LoanSummary instance with a specified fee charges due at disbursement.

methods.name: zeroFields
methods.description: Resets all summary fields to zero, except for 'totalFeeChargesDueAtDisbursement'.

methods.name: updateSummary
methods.description: Updates the summary fields based on repayment installments, charges, principal, and capitalized income details.

methods.name: updateTotalFeeChargesDueAtDisbursement
methods.description: Sets the total fee charges due at disbursement.

methods.name: getTotalFeeChargesDueAtDisbursement
methods.description: Returns the total fee charges due at disbursement as a Money object for a given currency.

methods.name: getTotalOutstanding
methods.description: Returns the total outstanding amount as a Money object for a given currency.

methods.name: updateFeeChargeOutstanding
methods.description: Updates the total fee charges outstanding.

methods.name: updatePenaltyChargeOutstanding
methods.description: Updates the total penalty charges outstanding.

methods.name: updateFeeChargesWaived
methods.description: Updates the total fee charges waived amount.

methods.name: updatePenaltyChargesWaived
methods.description: Updates the total penalty charges waived amount.

methods.name: isRepaidInFull
methods.description: Checks if the loan is fully repaid by verifying if the total outstanding is zero.

methods.name: updateTotalWaived
methods.description: Updates the total waived amount at the loan level.
